package com.x;
public class BCat extends BWebServlet {
  BValue enumValue(BEnum e, String tag) {
    try { return e.getRange().get((int) Double.parseDouble(tag), false); }
    catch (NumberFormatException nfe) { return e.getRange().get(tag); }
  }
  double zero(String s) {
    if (s == null) return 0.0;
    try { return Double.parseDouble(s.trim()); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { return 0.0; }
  }
  double fallback(String s) {
    try { return Double.parseDouble(s.trim()); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { return fallback; }
  }
  int conditional(String s) {
    try { return Integer.parseInt(s); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { return s.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1; }
  }
  void sideEffect(String tag) {
    try { v = Integer.parseInt(tag); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { v = lookup(tag); }
  }
  int other(String s, String d) {
    try { return Integer.parseInt(s); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { return lookup(d); }
  }
  double reread(String s) {
    try { return Double.parseDouble(s); }
    catch (NumberFormatException e) { return lookup(s.replace(',', '.')); }
  }
}
